title: AXI4 Video Frame Buffer
text: Model connection between two hardware algorithms through external memory, 3 inputs, 3 outputs, {Data type} sets Data type of video pixel; {Memory simulation} sets the simulation timing accuracy, {Memory selection} sets the between memory regions, {Region size (bytes)} sets the size of the allocated memory region, in bytes Read-only, {Frame size} sets the frame dimensions 1080p HDTV, {Number of Frames} sets the number of buffers in region, {Burst length}, {FIFO depth (number of bursts)} sets the depth of FIFO for data, {FIFO almost-full depth (number of bursts)} sets the depth of FIFO when backpressure, {Clock frequency (MHz)} sets the interconnect frequency of manager datapath, {Data width (bits)} sets the data width of manager datapath, {Dimensions}, {Sample time} sets the time interval of sampling, {Enable sample packing (last signal dimension as channel)} sets the pack data on last dimension of signal, {Inherit sample time offset} sets the make reader inherit sample time, {Use pixel clock sample times} and {View performance plots} displays performance metrics. Values come from the instance.
